description: This file defines the TestClusterBuilder class used for configuring and building test clusters in the Orleans distributed application framework. It includes methods for setting up cluster options, configuring silos and clients, and managing cluster properties.

classes.name: TestClusterBuilder
classes.description: A builder class for configuring and creating Orleans test clusters, including options for silos, ports, and cluster properties.

classes.name: ConfigureStaticClusterDeploymentOptions
classes.description: Internal class implementing IHostConfigurator to configure static cluster deployment options, specifically silo names based on the number of initial silos.

methods.name: TestClusterBuilder
methods.description: Constructor initializing the builder with default or specified number of silos.

methods.name: ConfigureBuilder
methods.description: Adds a configuration delegate to customize the configuration builder.

methods.name: ConfigureHostConfiguration
methods.description: Adds a delegate to configure the host configuration.

methods.name: AddSiloBuilderConfigurator
methods.description: Registers a silo configurator type for the cluster.

methods.name: AddClientBuilderConfigurator
methods.description: Registers a client configurator type for the cluster.

methods.name: Build
methods.description: Constructs and returns a configured TestCluster instance based on the current builder settings.

methods.name: CreateClusterId
methods.description: Generates a unique cluster identifier string.

methods.name: ConfigureDefaultPorts
methods.description: Sets default port ranges for silos and gateways if not already specified.
